params.prompt: Edit the FIRST image, a YouTube thumbnail. Keep EVERYTHING else exactly the same: the same man on the right (identical face, curly dark hair, green eyes, dark suit, white shirt, black tie, the same calm confident expression and pose), the same dark charcoal gradient background, the same heavy bold sans-serif font, the same left-side layout (white text on line 1, a white rectangular highlight box with black text on line 2). CHANGE 1: replace the round purple Ethereum coin at the top with the square logo from the SECOND image: the rounded square made of pink, purple, blue and peach interlocking shapes on black, reproduced faithfully as a glossy app-icon style badge with rounded corners, same size and position as the coin, with a soft glow around it in its own pink and blue colors. No ETH text, no coin. CHANGE 2: replace the headline text with exactly two lines: line 1 "My Latest" in white; line 2 "PUMP" in black inside the white highlight box, the box sized to the word. Spell every word exactly. No other text.
